newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Interport extends rights offer period.
newsitem.headline: Interport extends rights offer period.

text.p: Real estate developer Interport Resources Corp said on Wednesday it had decided to extend the offering period of its one-for-one rights by one more month.

Assistant corporate secretary Nestor Mesina told the Philippine Stock Exchange that many shareholders had asked for the extension since they were not able to raise enough funds to subscribe to the new shares.
The offer period was scheduled to end on Wednesday. It has been extended until July 11.
He said the offer period was shorter than the usual 45 days after Securities and Exchange Commission deferred its approval to the rights proposal until late May.
Mesina also said Mabuhay Holdings Corp which presently owns 43.6 percent had not signified its intention to subscribe to the new shares.
The managements of Mabuhay and Interport have been squabbling for more than a year due to differences.
